articles.title: Air Marshal Anil Chopra (R) on Op Sindoor, F 35 'Kill Switch', 28G Jet Ejection & Fighter Pilot Life
articles.description: India's air power faces major challenges, from a shortage of fighter squadrons and delays in Tejas production to the long road towards developing an indigenous jet engine. In this episode of Line of Defence, retired Air Marshal Anil Chopra joins TOI Digital’s National Editor Meghna Deka, to discuss the future of the Indian Air Force, India's fighter aircraft requirements and the changing nature of aerial warfare. From Rafale and F-35 to Tejas, AMCA and the Su-30MKI upgrade, he explains India's aircraft choices, defence indigenisation and the geopolitical considerations behind military procurement. The conversation also examines Operation Sindoor, China's military support to Pakistan, the possibility of a two-front conflict, and whether drones and artificial intelligence will change the future of fighter pilots.
